-- Relational evaluation preserves input encounter order through every operator.
import Json (..)
import Model (..)
import Binder (tree_any)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, length, sum)

pub fn compare_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (JInt(x), JInt(y)) =>
      if x < y then
        -1
      elif x > y then
        1
      else
        0
    (JStr(x), JStr(y)) => str_cmp(x, y)
    (JBool(x), JBool(y)) =>
      if x == y then
        0
      elif x then
        1
      else
        -1
    _ => 0

pub fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" then
      if length(e.args) == 0 then
        JInt(length(group))
      else
        JInt(length(filter(\(r) -> not(is_null(evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []))), group)))
    else
      let vs = filter(
          \(v) -> not(is_null(v)),
          map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group),
        )
      if op == "SUM" then
        if length(vs) == 0 then JNull else JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  elif op == "COALESCE" then
    coalesce(e.args, row, group)
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "ISNULL" then
      JBool(is_null(a))
    elif op == "ISNOTNULL" then
      JBool(not(is_null(a)))
    elif op == "NOT" then
      if is_null(a) then JNull else JBool(not(truth(a)))
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "AND" then
        and_value(a, b)
      elif op == "OR" then
        or_value(a, b)
      elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        JNull
      elif op == "+" then
        JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

fn coalesce(args : List(Expr), row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  match args of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(e, rest) =>
      let v = evaluate(e, row, group)
      if is_null(v) then coalesce(rest, row, group) else v

fn and_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Json =
  if not(is_null(a)) && not(truth(a)) || not(is_null(b)) && not(truth(b)) then
    JBool(false)
  elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
    JNull
  else
    JBool(true)

fn or_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Json =
  if not(is_null(a)) && truth(a) || not(is_null(b)) && truth(b) then
    JBool(true)
  elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
    JNull
  else
    JBool(false)

fn extremum(vs : List(Json), minimum : Bool) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, Nil) => v
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      let b = extremum(rest, minimum)
      if (compare_value(v, b) < 0) == minimum then
        v
      else
        b

pub fn fold_constants(e : Expr) : Expr =
  let n = Expr { ..e, args = map(fold_constants, e.args) }
  if (not(agg(n.op))
      && not(elem(n.op, ["lit", "col"]))
      && all(\(a) -> a.op == "lit", n.args)) then
    literal(evaluate(n, [], []))
  else
    n

fn conjuncts(e : Expr) : List(Expr) =
  if e.op == "AND" then
    append(conjuncts(at(e.args, 0)), conjuncts(at(e.args, 1)))
  else
    [e]

fn sources(e : Expr) : List(Int) =
  if e.op == "col" then
    [e.source]
  else
    flatten(map(sources, e.args))

fn combine(es : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  match es of
    Nil => literal(JBool(true))
    Cons(e, Nil) => e
    Cons(e, rest) => Expr { ..node("AND", [e, combine(rest)]), kind = "bool" }

fn can_push(e : Expr, table_count : Int, left_joins : List(Bool)) : Bool =
  let ss = sources(e)
  let source = if length(ss) > 0 then at(ss, 0) else -1
  table_count > 1
    && length(ss) > 0
    && all(\(s) -> s == source, ss)
    && all(\(left) -> not(left), take(source, left_joins))

-- Push a conjunct only when every referenced slot belongs to one inner-join
-- input. Slot numbers remain global; scan predicates receive a prefix padding.
pub fn optimize(plan : Plan) : Plan =
  let q = plan.query
  let terms = conjuncts(fold_constants(q.predicate))
  let pushable = \(e) -> can_push(e, length(plan.tables), q.left_joins)
  let fs = map(
      \(i) -> filter(\(e) -> pushable(e) && at(sources(e), 0) == i, terms),
      range(0, length(plan.tables)),
    )
  let rem = filter(\(e) -> not(pushable(e)), terms)
  let bq = Query {
    ..q,
    predicate = combine(rem),
    select = map(\(s) -> (fold_constants(fst(s)), snd(s)), q.select),
    joins = map(fold_constants, q.joins),
    having = fold_constants(q.having)
  }
  Plan { ..plan, query = bq, filters = fs }

fn join_rows(
  left : List(List(Json)),
  right : List(List(Json)),
  on : Expr,
  outer : Bool,
  right_width : Int
) : List(List(Json)) =
  flatten(
      map(
          \(l) ->
            let matches = filter(
                \(r) -> truth(evaluate(on, r, [])),
                map(\(r) -> append(l, r), right),
              ) in
            if outer && length(matches) == 0 then
              [append(l, replicate(right_width, JNull))]
            else
              matches,
          left,
        ),
    )

pub type Group = Group { key: String, rows: List(List(Json)) }

fn add_group(gs : List(Group), key : String, row : List(Json)) : List(Group) =
  match gs of
    Nil => [Group { key = key, rows = [row] }]
    Cons(g, rest) =>
      if g.key == key then
        Cons(Group { ..g, rows = append(g.rows, [row]) }, rest)
      else
        Cons(g, add_group(rest, key, row))

fn groups_for(rows : List(List(Json)), keys : List(Expr)) : List(Group) =
  var gs := []
  for row in sof(rows) do
    let key = encode(JArr(map(\(e) -> evaluate(e, row, []), keys)))
    gs := add_group(gs, key, row)
  if length(keys) == 0 && length(rows) == 0 then
    [Group { key = "[]", rows = [] }]
  else
    gs

fn project(
  q : Query,
  row : List(Json),
  group : List(List(Json))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  if truth(evaluate(q.having, row, group)) then
    [map(\(s) -> evaluate(fst(s), row, group), q.select)]
  else
    []

fn distinct_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  seen : List(String)
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) =>
      let key = encode(JArr(r))
      if elem(key, seen) then
        distinct_rows(rest, seen)
      else
        Cons(r, distinct_rows(rest, Cons(key, seen)))

fn row_compare(
  a : List(Json),
  b : List(Json),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Int))
) : Int =
  match order of
    Nil => 0
    Cons((i, desc, nulls), rest) =>
      let av = at(a, i)
      let bv = at(b, i)
      let nulls_first = nulls == 1 || nulls == 0 && desc
      let c =
        if is_null(av) && is_null(bv) then 0
        elif is_null(av) then if nulls_first then -1 else 1
        elif is_null(bv) then if nulls_first then 1 else -1
        else compare_value(av, bv)
      if c == 0 then
        row_compare(a, b, rest)
      elif desc && not(is_null(av)) && not(is_null(bv)) then
        -c
      else
        c

fn insert_row(
  r : List(Json),
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Int))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => [r]
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      if row_compare(r, x, order) <= 0 then
        Cons(r, rows)
      else
        Cons(x, insert_row(r, rest, order))

fn sort_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Int))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) => insert_row(r, sort_rows(rest, order), order)

pub fn execute(plan : Plan) : Json =
  let q = plan.query
  var scans := []
  var offset := 0
  for i in srange(0, length(plan.tables)) do
    let t = at(plan.tables, i)
    let padding = replicate(offset, JNull)
    let predicates = at(plan.filters, i)
    let rs = filter(
        \(r) -> all(\(p) -> truth(evaluate(p, append(padding, r), [])), predicates),
        t.rows,
      )
    scans := append(scans, [rs])
    offset += length(t.columns)
  var rows := at(scans, 0)
  for i in srange(0, length(q.joins)) do
    rows := join_rows(
        rows,
        at(scans, i + 1),
        at(q.joins, i),
        at(q.left_joins, i),
        length(at(plan.tables, i + 1).columns),
      )
  let filtered = filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(q.predicate, r, [])), rows)
  let projected =
    if plan.aggregate then
      flatten(
          map(
              \(g) -> project(q, if length(g.rows) > 0 then at(g.rows, 0) else [], g.rows),
              groups_for(filtered, q.groups),
            ),
        )
    else
      flatten(map(\(r) -> project(q, r, []), filtered))
  let distinct =
    if q.distinct then
      distinct_rows(projected, [])
    else
      projected
  let sorted =
    if length(plan.order) > 0 then
      sort_rows(distinct, plan.order)
    else
      distinct
  let skipped = drop(q.offset, sorted)
  let final =
    if q.limit >= 0 then
      take(q.limit, skipped)
    else
      skipped
  JObj([
      ("columns", JArr(map(\(s) -> JStr(snd(s)), q.select))),
      ("rows", JArr(map(JArr, final))),
    ])

-- Typed syntax and bound logical plan. JSON is used only for wire values.
import Json (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, length)

pub effect Domain
  never reject(String) : Unit

pub fn demand(b : Bool, code : String) : Unit =
  if not(b) then
    reject(code)

pub fn arr(j : Json) : List(Json) =
  match j of
    JArr(xs) => xs
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      []

pub fn text(j : Json) : String =
  match j of
    JStr(s) => s
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      ""

pub fn integer(j : Json) : Int =
  match j of
    JInt(n) => n
    _ => 0

pub fn truth(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JBool(b) => b
    _ => false

pub fn getfield(j : Json, key : String) : Json =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) => lookup_field(xs, key)
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull

fn lookup_field(xs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match xs of
    Nil =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull
    Cons((k, v), rest) =>
      if k == key then
        v
      else
        lookup_field(rest, key)

pub fn fields(j : Json, names : List(String)) : Unit =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) =>
      demand(length(xs) == length(names), "INVALID_INPUT")
      demand(
          all(
              \(name) -> length(filter(\(kv) -> fst(kv) == name, xs)) == 1,
              names,
            ),
          "INVALID_INPUT",
        )
    _ => reject("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn reserved(s : String) : Bool =
  elem(
      to_upper(s),
      split(
          32,
          "SELECT DISTINCT AS FROM INNER JOIN LEFT OUTER ON WHERE GROUP BY HAVING ORDER ASC DESC NULLS FIRST LAST LIMIT OFFSET AND OR NOT IS NULL TRUE FALSE COALESCE COUNT SUM MIN MAX",
        ),
    )

pub fn letter(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 97 && c <= 122 || c == 95

pub fn digit(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 48 && c <= 57

pub fn name_ok(s : String) : Bool =
  byte_len(s) > 0
    && letter(byte_at(s, 0))
    && all(
        \(i) -> letter(byte_at(s, i)) || digit(byte_at(s, i)),
        range(0, byte_len(s)),
      )
    && not(reserved(s))

pub fn value_type(v : Json) : String =
  match v of
    JInt(_) => "int"
    JBool(_) => "bool"
    JStr(_) => "text"
    JNull => "null"
    _ => "invalid"

pub fn is_null(v : Json) : Bool =
  match v of
    JNull => true
    _ => false

pub type Column = Column {
  name: String,
  kind: String,
  qualifier: String,
  source: Int,
  index: Int,
  nullable: Bool
}

pub type Table = Table {
  name: String,
  columns: List(Column),
  rows: List(List(Json))
}

pub type Expr = Expr {
  op: String,
  value: Json,
  qualifier: String,
  name: String,
  args: List(Expr),
  kind: String,
  index: Int,
  source: Int
}

pub fn node(op : String, args : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  Expr {
    op = op,
    value = JNull,
    qualifier = "",
    name = "",
    args = args,
    kind = "",
    index = -1,
    source = -1
  }

pub fn literal(v : Json) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("lit", []), value = v, kind = value_type(v) }

pub fn column_ref(q : String, n : String) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("col", []), qualifier = q, name = n }

pub fn agg(op : String) : Bool = elem(op, ["COUNT", "SUM", "MIN", "MAX"])

pub fn at(xs : List(a), i : Int) : a =
  match nth(i, xs) of
    Some(x) => x
    None => at(xs, i)

pub type Query = Query {
  select: List((Expr, String)),
  sources: List((String, String)),
  joins: List(Expr),
  left_joins: List(Bool),
  predicate: Expr,
  groups: List(Expr),
  having: Expr,
  has_having: Bool,
  order: List((String, Bool, Int)),
  distinct: Bool,
  limit: Int,
  offset: Int
}

pub type Plan = Plan {
  query: Query,
  tables: List(Table),
  filters: List(List(Expr)),
  aggregate: Bool,
  order: List((Int, Bool, Int))
}

pub fn validate_table(j : Json) : Table =
  fields(j, ["name", "columns", "rows"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  demand(name_ok(n), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let cs = map(validate_column, arr(getfield(j, "columns")))
  demand(length(cs) > 0, "INVALID_INPUT")
  demand(unique(map(\(c) -> c.name, cs)), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let rows = map(arr, arr(getfield(j, "rows")))
  for row in sof(rows) do
    demand(length(row) == length(cs), "INVALID_INPUT")
    for i in srange(0, length(cs)) do
      let v = at(row, i)
      demand(
          value_type(v) == at(cs, i).kind || is_null(v) && at(cs, i).nullable,
          "INVALID_INPUT",
        )
  Table { name = n, columns = cs, rows = rows }

fn validate_column(j : Json) : Column =
  fields(j, ["name", "type", "nullable"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  let t = text(getfield(j, "type"))
  demand(name_ok(n) && elem(t, ["int", "text", "bool"]), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let nullable =
    match getfield(j, "nullable") of
      JBool(b) => b
      _ =>
        reject("INVALID_INPUT")
        false
  Column {
    name = n,
    kind = t,
    qualifier = "",
    source = 0,
    index = 0,
    nullable = nullable
  }

pub fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

pub fn elem(x : a, xs : List(a)) : Bool given Eq(a) =
  match xs of
    Nil => false
    Cons(y, rest) => x == y || elem(x, rest)

defs.name: compatible
common_kind
check
defs.source:
fn check(e : Expr, columns : List(Column), allow : Bool, inside : Bool) : Expr =
  if e.op == "col" then
    let matches = filter(
        \(c) -> c.name == e.name && (e.qualifier == "" || e.qualifier == c.qualifier),
        columns,
      )
    demand(length(matches) > 0, "UNKNOWN_COLUMN")
    demand(length(matches) == 1, "AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN")
    let c = at(matches, 0)
    Expr { ..e, index = c.index, source = c.source, kind = c.kind }
  elif e.op == "lit" then
    e
  else
    let isagg = agg(e.op)
    demand(not(isagg) || allow && not(inside), "INVALID_AGGREGATION")
    let args = map(\(a) -> check(a, columns, allow, inside || isagg), e.args)
    let ts = map(\(a) -> a.kind, args)
    let kind =
      if e.op == "COUNT" then
        "int"
      elif elem(e.op, ["SUM", "+", "-", "*"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> elem(t, ["int", "null"]), ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "int"
      elif elem(e.op, ["MIN", "MAX"]) then
        demand(elem(at(ts, 0), ["int", "text"]), "TYPE_ERROR")
        at(ts, 0)
      elif elem(e.op, ["NOT", "AND", "OR"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> elem(t, ["bool", "null"]), ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "bool"
      elif elem(e.op, ["ISNULL", "ISNOTNULL"]) then
        "bool"
      elif e.op == "COALESCE" then
        demand(compatible(ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        common_kind(ts)
      else
        demand(
            compatible(ts)
              && (common_kind(ts) /= "bool" || elem(e.op, ["=", "<>"])),
            "TYPE_ERROR",
          )
        "bool"
    Expr { ..e, args = args, kind = kind }

defs.name: predicate
tree_any
defs.source:
fn tree_any(p : (Expr) -> Bool, e : Expr) : Bool =
  p(e) || any(\(a) -> tree_any(p, a), e.args)

defs.name: grouped
defs.source:
fn grouped(e : Expr, keys : List(Int)) : Unit =
  if not(agg(e.op)) then
    demand(e.op /= "col" || elem(e.index, keys), "INVALID_AGGREGATION")
    for a in sof(e.args) do
      grouped(a, keys)

defs.name: find_table
bind
alias_index
defs.source:
fn alias_index(names : List(String), n : String, i : Int) : Int =
  match names of
    Nil =>
      reject("UNKNOWN_COLUMN")
      -1
    Cons(a, rest) =>
      if a == n then
        i
      else
        alias_index(rest, n, i + 1)

defs.name: compare_value
defs.source:
fn compare_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (JInt(x), JInt(y)) =>
      if x < y then
        -1
      elif x > y then
        1
      else
        0
    (JStr(x), JStr(y)) => str_cmp(x, y)
    (JBool(x), JBool(y)) =>
      if x == y then
        0
      elif x then
        1
      else
        -1
    _ => 0

defs.name: evaluate
defs.source:
fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" then
      if length(e.args) == 0 then
        JInt(length(group))
      else
        JInt(length(filter(\(r) -> not(is_null(evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []))), group)))
    else
      let vs = filter(
          \(v) -> not(is_null(v)),
          map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group),
        )
      if op == "SUM" then
        if length(vs) == 0 then JNull else JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  elif op == "COALESCE" then
    coalesce(e.args, row, group)
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "ISNULL" then
      JBool(is_null(a))
    elif op == "ISNOTNULL" then
      JBool(not(is_null(a)))
    elif op == "NOT" then
      if is_null(a) then JNull else JBool(not(truth(a)))
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "AND" then
        and_value(a, b)
      elif op == "OR" then
        or_value(a, b)
      elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        JNull
      elif op == "+" then
        JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

fn and_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Json =
  if not(is_null(a)) && not(truth(a)) || not(is_null(b)) && not(truth(b)) then
    JBool(false)
  elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
    JNull
  else
    JBool(true)

defs.name: or_value
defs.source:
fn or_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Json =
  if not(is_null(a)) && truth(a) || not(is_null(b)) && truth(b) then
    JBool(true)
  elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
    JNull
  else
    JBool(false)

defs.name: extremum
defs.source:
fn extremum(vs : List(Json), minimum : Bool) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, Nil) => v
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      let b = extremum(rest, minimum)
      if (compare_value(v, b) < 0) == minimum then
        v
      else
        b

  else
    [e]

fn join_rows(
  left : List(List(Json)),
  right : List(List(Json)),
  on : Expr,
  outer : Bool,
  right_width : Int
) : List(List(Json)) =
  flatten(
      map(
          \(l) ->
            let matches = filter(
                \(r) -> truth(evaluate(on, r, [])),
                map(\(r) -> append(l, r), right),
              ) in
            if outer && length(matches) == 0 then
              [append(l, replicate(right_width, JNull))]
            else
              matches,
          left,
        ),
    )

defs.source: type Group = Group { key: String, rows: List(List(Json)) }

defs.name: add_group
defs.source:
fn add_group(gs : List(Group), key : String, row : List(Json)) : List(Group) =
  match gs of
    Nil => [Group { key = key, rows = [row] }]
    Cons(g, rest) =>
      if g.key == key then
        Cons(Group { ..g, rows = append(g.rows, [row]) }, rest)
      else
        Cons(g, add_group(rest, key, row))

defs.name: groups_for
defs.source:
fn groups_for(rows : List(List(Json)), keys : List(Expr)) : List(Group) =
  var gs := []
  for row in sof(rows) do
    let key = encode(JArr(map(\(e) -> evaluate(e, row, []), keys)))
    gs := add_group(gs, key, row)
  if length(keys) == 0 && length(rows) == 0 then
    [Group { key = "[]", rows = [] }]
  else
    gs

defs.source:
fn distinct_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  seen : List(String)
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) =>
      let key = encode(JArr(r))
      if elem(key, seen) then
        distinct_rows(rest, seen)
      else
        Cons(r, distinct_rows(rest, Cons(key, seen)))

defs.name: row_compare
defs.source:
fn row_compare(
  a : List(Json),
  b : List(Json),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Int))
) : Int =
  match order of
    Nil => 0
    Cons((i, desc, nulls), rest) =>
      let av = at(a, i)
      let bv = at(b, i)
      let nulls_first = nulls == 1 || nulls == 0 && desc
      let c =
        if is_null(av) && is_null(bv) then 0
        elif is_null(av) then if nulls_first then -1 else 1
        elif is_null(bv) then if nulls_first then 1 else -1
        else compare_value(av, bv)
      if c == 0 then
        row_compare(a, b, rest)
      elif desc && not(is_null(av)) && not(is_null(bv)) then
        -c
      else
        c

defs.name: insert_row
defs.source:
fn insert_row(
  r : List(Json),
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Int))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => [r]
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      if row_compare(r, x, order) <= 0 then
        Cons(r, rows)
      else
        Cons(x, insert_row(r, rest, order))

defs.name: sort_rows

fn sort_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Int))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) => insert_row(r, sort_rows(rest, order), order)

defs.name: scan_string
defs.source:
fn scan_string(s : String, i : Int, acc : String) : (String, Int) =
  demand(i < byte_len(s), "PARSE_ERROR")
  if byte_at(s, i) == 39 then
    if i + 1 < byte_len(s) && byte_at(s, i + 1) == 39 then
      scan_string(s, i + 2, concat(acc, "'"))
    else
      (acc, i + 1)
  else
    scan_string(s, i + 1, concat(acc, str_of_char(chr(byte_at(s, i)))))

defs.name: scan_word
defs.source:
fn scan_word(s : String, i : Int, numbers : Bool) : Int =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then
    i
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    if (digit(c) || not(numbers) && (letter(c) || c >= 65 && c <= 90)) then
      scan_word(s, i + 1, numbers)
    else
      i

defs.name: lex
defs.source:
fn lex(s : String, i : Int) : List(Token) =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then
    [tok("$END")]
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    if elem(c, [32, 9, 10, 13]) then
      lex(s, i + 1)
    elif c == 39 then
      let (v, j) = scan_string(s, i + 1, "")
      Cons(Token { word = "LITERAL", value = JStr(v) }, lex(s, j))
    elif digit(c) then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, true)
      let n =
        match parse_int(slice(s, i, j)) of
          Some(v) => v
          None => 0
      Cons(Token { word = "NUMBER", value = JInt(n) }, lex(s, j))
    elif letter(c) || c >= 65 && c <= 90 then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, false)
      let w = slice(s, i, j)
      Cons(tok(if reserved(w) then to_upper(w) else w), lex(s, j))
    else
      let two = slice(s, i, min(i + 2, byte_len(s)))
      if elem(two, ["<>", "<=", ">="]) then
        Cons(tok(two), lex(s, i + 2))
      else
        demand(
            elem(c, [40, 41, 44, 46, 59, 43, 45, 42, 61, 60, 62]),
            "PARSE_ERROR",
          )
        Cons(tok(str_of_char(chr(c))), lex(s, i + 1))

fn precedence(op : String) : Int =
  if op == "OR" then
    1
  elif op == "AND" then
    2
  elif elem(op, ["=", "<>", "<", ">", "<=", ">="]) then
    4
  elif elem(op, ["+", "-"]) then
    5
  elif op == "*" then
    6
  else
    0

defs.name: expression
defs.source:
fn expression(minimum : Int) : Expr =
  let t = pop()
  let w = t.word
  let e =
    if w == "NOT" then
      node(w, [expression(3)])
    elif w == "(" then
      let x = expression(1)
      expect(")")
      x
    elif w == "-" then
      literal(JInt(-natural()))
    elif elem(w, ["NUMBER", "LITERAL"]) then
      literal(t.value)
    elif elem(w, ["TRUE", "FALSE"]) then
      literal(JBool(w == "TRUE"))
    elif w == "NULL" then
      literal(JNull)
    elif w == "COALESCE" then
      expect("(")
      let first = expression(1)
      expect(",")
      let args = coalesce_args([first])
      expect(")")
      node("COALESCE", args)
    elif agg(w) then
      expect("(")
      let args =
        if w == "COUNT" && accept("*") then
          []
        else
          [expression(1)]
      expect(")")
      node(w, args)
    else
      demand(name_ok(w), "PARSE_ERROR")
      if accept(".") then
        column_ref(w, name())
      else
        column_ref("", w)
  binary(e, minimum, false)

defs.name: query
defs.source:
fn query() : Query =
  expect("SELECT")
  let distinct = accept("DISTINCT")
  let sels = selections()
  expect("FROM")
  let (ss, js, ls) = join_sources([source()], [], [])
  let pred =
    if accept("WHERE") then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let groups =
    if accept("GROUP") then
      expect("BY")
      group_keys()
    else
      []
  let hh = accept("HAVING")
  let hav =
    if hh then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let order =
    if accept("ORDER") then
      expect("BY")
      order_keys()
    else
      []
  let lim =
    if accept("LIMIT") then
      natural()
    else
      -1
  let off =
    if lim >= 0 && accept("OFFSET") then
      natural()
    else
      0
  let ignored = accept(";")
  demand(peek() == "$END", "PARSE_ERROR")
  Query {
    select = sels,
    sources = ss,
    joins = js,
    left_joins = ls,
    predicate = pred,
    groups = groups,
    having = hav,
    has_having = hh,
    order = order,
    distinct = distinct,
    limit = lim,
    offset = off
  }
